def transform(grid):
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0])
    bg = 9
    special = 8
    fill = 2
    
    # Find all special positions
    special_positions = set()
    for r in range(rows):
        for c in range(cols):
            if grid[r][c] == special:
                special_positions.add((r, c))
    
    # Create result grid as copy
    result = [list(row) for row in grid]
    
    # Find horizontal spans (between consecutive special in same row)
    h_spans = []
    for r in range(rows):
        indices = [c for c in range(cols) if (r, c) in special_positions]
        for i in range(len(indices) - 1):
            start, end = indices[i], indices[i+1]
            h_spans.append((r, start, end))
    
    # Find vertical spans (between consecutive special in same col)
    v_spans = []
    for c in range(cols):
        indices = [r for r in range(rows) if (r, c) in special_positions]
        for i in range(len(indices) - 1):
            start, end = indices[i], indices[i+1]
            v_spans.append((start, c, end))
    
    # Fill cells in spans
    for r in range(rows):
        for c in range(cols):
            if grid[r][c] == bg:
                in_h = any(hr == r and hs < c < he for hr, hs, he in h_spans)
                in_v = any(vc == c and vs < r < ve for vc, vs, ve in v_spans)
                if in_h or in_v:
                    result[r][c] = fill
    
    return result
